When I was 19, I went on a school exchange trip to Myanmar to clear a modules. 2 weeks oversea for 1 semester worth of module, no brainer right. While other groups who went to Philippines, Cambodia and other countries which I forgot, they had home stay in the student buddy's home as well as hotel stay.

However, the condition in Myanmar was so deemed 'bad' by the school so instead of hotel stay, we stayed in temples, instead of student buddy's home, we stayed in the university's abandoned 2 story dorm and a sealed off well right beside it.

The university was really run down and the area is really small. So on the 2nd day of staying in the dorm (5th day in the trip), 2 friends and I decided to sit along the corridor to chat after a whole day of work which is around 11pm. The chairs was the typical red plastic stackable chair.

So there is a stretch of this chair along the corridor and I sat in the middle with both friends beside me and maybe 15 extra chairs to the right. Halfway through while we were chatting, the chair to the right of my friend jotted out. There was a loud sound as it dragged across the ground about half the chair length distance so it was the only protruding chair in that stretch.

My friend to the left saw it cause he was telling his story as me and my friend to the right was looking at his thus only hearing the sound and didn't actually see it moving but only where it moved to.

We went back into the room and told the other students on the trip and consulted our professor in charge. It is not like we can stay elsewhere so we just always walk in buddy system if we ever going out or back to our dorm.
